annotations.text: GET /api/v1/forms — saved templates with field / step counts, status, author. Row opens the read-only view; “New form” opens the builder.

POST /api/v1/forms — the core screen. Form name + description, dynamically added fields (Text / Date / Number / Checkbox / Dropdown), and the approval route. Live preview on the right. Order follows list position; arrows reorder.
GET /api/v1/forms/{id} — read-only. The built form rendered as disabled inputs; the approval route shown as a numbered stepper with action-type tags.
Reactive Forms validation — inline errors on blur, a summary banner listing every issue, and Save disabled until the whole form is valid.
Form list — empty state shown on first run, before any template exists.
